svg.title: Complete ID card types and fields plan
svg.desc: All ID card types with their specific fields, common fields, extra info option, and final WhatsApp order confirmation flow.

g.text: School: school name, student name, class, roll no., blood group
Company: company, name, designation, dept., employee ID
Hospital: hospital, name, role, dept., reg. no.
Gym/Club/Library: org. name, member name, ID, expiry date
Photo upload · Logo / org. logo upload
Card size: CR80 standard / custom size
Lanyard hole: yes / no · Lamination: yes / no
Design style: plain / with border / custom layout
"Do you want to add anything else to the card?"
Free-text box: QR code link, emergency contact,
barcode no., special instructions, back-side content
Delivery or pickup · Your contact number
Confirm → send to WhatsApp / call Manju Enterprises
